deviation: The draft replaces written acceptance after at least 10 business days of testing with deemed acceptance 3 calendar days after delivery unless the Customer objects. This is worse than the fallback (deemed acceptance only after 15 business days of silence). Arcadia could lose its right to test and reject defective deliverables, and the short window makes silence count as acceptance.
suggested_text: A deliverable is accepted only when the Customer confirms acceptance in writing after not less than 10 business days of testing. No deliverable shall be deemed accepted by reason of silence, delay, or use.
